Name: Luxair
Company description: Luxair is the flag carrier airline of Luxembourg, established in 1962, and has been a cornerstone of the country's air transport services for over 60 years. The airline offers a comprehensive range of services, including passenger flights, holiday packages, and cargo transport, with a mission to connect Luxembourg to key destinations across Europe and beyond. Luxair prioritizes safety, punctuality, and customer satisfaction, ensuring that every travel experience is exceptional. Operating a modern fleet that includes Boeing and De Havilland aircraft, Luxair is committed to providing efficient and environmentally friendly travel options. The airline serves a diverse clientele, encompassing leisure travelers, business professionals, and families, and collaborates with various partners, such as German Airways, to enhance its service offerings. Luxair's vision emphasizes a commitment to safety, service excellence, and community engagement, reflecting its dedication to social responsibility. The company actively supports initiatives like Stand Speak Rise Up!, which advocates for victims of sexual violence in conflict zones, and partners with local artists and charities, such as the Think Pink organization for breast cancer awareness. With a focus on innovation and sustainability, Luxair continually adapts to the evolving aviation landscape while celebrating its Luxembourgish heritage. The airline aims to expand its network and improve its fleet, ensuring a bright future for both the company and its passengers. By fostering connections between people and cultures, Luxair not only enhances travel experiences but also contributes positively to the communities it serves.

Name: SkyRadar
Company description: SkyRadar is the first commercially available educational radar & SMC training system for ATSEP and military users. Operating within the milliwatt range, the SkyRadar radar training system is completely safe for indoor and outdoor experiments. SkyRadar provides radar kits blended with training curricula and scenarios for high level skills development. The SkyRadar Training System was developed in partnership with leading companies from the Air Traffic Management industry, independent specialists and a globally experienced systems integrator. SkyRadar investigates the function and applications of modern primary and secondary radars through practical experiments. From civil air traffic control to military and EW applications, all topics are covered by an unsurpassed number of interesting experiments Conventional educations systems usually only allow "black box" examinations.  What takes place inside the devices remains a mystery to the student.  The SkyRadar Modules give students an opportunity to work with real radars and build up or modify in real-time the Digital Signal Processing Block Diagrams.
